text:
Mina (PM): Rally thread to finalize Reserved Pools GA gates. We need a minimal spec for quotas, burst credits, and autoscale fallbacks by EOD Fri.

Jules (Eng-Platform): Proposed MVP: allocation API, token-bucket per-tenant, simple autoscale policy (min/max tied to commitment), fallback order: quantized -> smaller-model -> short-queue. No per-route controls for MVP.

Kai (Eng-SRE): Ops needs: headroom metric, fallback.reason traces, alert if fallback.active > 2m, and synthetic 5m burst test. Defaults: queue_ms=100, burst_window_s=300, carryover_pct=10.

Rhea (Customer Success): Pilots ask for visible console banner when fallback occurs, and email for sustained fallback >2m. They also want contract text that explains quality delta and opt-out.

Oscar (Legal): Draft fallback clause: Redwood may route to lower-fidelity variants during saturation; customers can opt-out for specific routes. We'll keep SLA language conservative.

Mina (PM): Launch KPIs: P95 latency <=250ms for reserved traffic, <=1% fallback rate under normal traffic, ability to absorb 5m bursts for 90% of events, onboarding time <2h. Gate: MUST features implemented + 2 pilot signoffs + legal clause.

Jules (Eng-Platform): I'll open a small PR with autoscale JSON + token-bucket schema by Thu. Sample: {"policy":"mvp","scale_up_pct":80,"scale_down_pct":35,"min":2,"max":"commit_base*3","queue_ms":100,"fallback":["quantized","small","queue"]}.

Kai (Eng-SRE): I'll add alerts and chaos checklist to the PR. Also ensure fallback.reason and model_variant are in traces for post-mortems.

Rhea (Customer Success): I'll collect pilot redlines and push for the banner to be MUST if Pilot A insists.

task-bot: Created PROD-1701 "Reserved pools GA playbook" assigned to Mina/Jules/Kai/Rhea. Due 1715620000.

Mina (PM): Quick reactions: :thumbsup: if you agree with the gates, :eyes: to discuss.

Jules (Eng-Platform): :thumbsup:

Kai (Eng-SRE): :thumbsup: but will sync on prewarm cost question in 1:1.

Rhea (Customer Success): :eyes: may nudge banner to MUST.

Oscar (Legal): :thumbsup:

Mina (PM): OK—standup tomorrow 09:30 to confirm PR link and legal blurb. Thanks.
